notes: Medium bucket (sum=15), matching the three competency floors (each floor=medium): the agent must bring up a tiny busybox guest under software-emulated QEMU (TCG, no /dev/kvm), wire a QEMU user-mode hostfwd so a host loopback port reaches the guest's dropbear sshd, and leave the emulator running as a daemonized background process (qemu -daemonize -pidfile) that outlives the launching shell (C-2c651297, C-20878051). Independently it must repair /usr/bin/curl into a genuine native ELF executable with the exec bit and a recognised identity, and prove a live loopback fetch returns the true remote bytes (C-973755e1). Hidden generalization and idempotency probes re-invoke the delivered scripts against other URLs/args and re-run the guest; TCG boot latency and the persistent-daemon requirement drive resource_pressure/interaction_statefulness. All three competency floors are met at the medium bucket.
